axes.A: External action conditions and ego outputs; record future information separately
axes.I: Mechanism producing other-agent response, not proof of response validity
axes.U: Stage at which prediction is used
axes.V: Reference and feedback process actually tested

evidence_status.D: Direct test of the specified endpoint; not a quality score
evidence_status.P: Proxy, selected qualitative evidence, or indirect association for the specified claim
evidence_status.X: The inspected test addresses a different endpoint; not proof of incapability
evidence_status.NR: Unresolved in the inspected material; not a negative result

missing_value_rule: null means not extracted, not zero and not necessarily absent from the source
aggregation_rule: Do not treat task records as independent studies or estimate field-wide prevalence
coder_rule: Single AI-assisted reconstruction; no independent second-coder agreement is claimed
